values./items/@69d08d2fe1f7adc2/system/descript: Once per combat, the Merchant may ‘let rip’ with a volley from their 10mm Auto Pistol. This adds the weapon’s Fire Rate of 4 to the weapon’s damage for a single attack (for 7 CD total) and allows them to use the Burst damage effect without spending ammo.
